anchor.quote: Live Q&A works by the agent editing files and the viewer polling

thread.text: seems like the live qa is not really working?

The viewer's half worked: it polls the files every 2s (both of your messages landed in this sidecar live). What failed is the agent's half — I ran the session as a background task and was only woken when it *exited*, so I never saw the `question.asked` event mid-session. The fix is on my side of the flow: watch the session's event stream while it runs (I'll do that in the next session) instead of waiting for exit. No code change needed, though I can also add it to the skill text so any agent does this.
